issue: DistantHorizonsStandalone #72 - GTNH crashing when this mod is added

findings.summary: GTNH modpack crashes when DistantHorizons is added. The mod has GTCompat integration via ForgeMain.gtCompat which is conditionally enabled when gregtech mod is loaded and IBlockWithTextures class is available.
findings.root_cause: The GTCompat class likely has compatibility issues with newer GTNH versions. The enableGTCompat() check in ForgeMain.java:71-78 only verifies class existence but doesn't validate API compatibility.
evidence: ForgeMain.java:44: public static GTCompat gtCompat; - static field accessible from any thread
TargetedMod.java:10: ANGELICA is explicitly targeted but GTNH/GT5 isn't listed as targeted mod

primary.issue: Class existence check doesn't guarantee API compatibility with GTNH version
GTCompat instantiated without version checking or error handling

related.note: GTNH integration class - needs examination for API compatibility

gap_analysis.current_behavior: GTCompat is enabled whenever gregtech mod is loaded and IBlockWithTextures class exists, without version validation
gap_analysis.required_behavior: GTCompat should validate GTNH/GT5 version compatibility before enabling, or gracefully degrade
gap_analysis.invariant_violated: Mod compatibility assumes class presence implies API compatibility

proposed_fix.approach: Add version checking and graceful error handling for GTCompat initialization similar to AngelicaCompat.verifyAngelicaVersion()
implementation_steps: 2. Implement verifyGTVersion() method in GTCompat class
3. Wrap gtCompat initialization in try-catch with user-friendly error message
4. If version check fails, log warning and continue without GTCompat
proposed_fix.code_changes: Add version range check before GTCompat instantiation; wrap in try-catch

falsification_test.description: Test with different GTNH versions (5.09.50.x, 5.09.51.x, 5.09.52.x). If crash occurs on all versions, root cause is different.
steps: 3. If crash occurs on all versions, issue is not version-specific
4. Check logs for NoClassDefFoundError or NoSuchMethodError in GTCompat

confidence_reason: Root cause identified through code inspection but no crash logs provided to confirm. Pattern matches Angelica version check implementation which was added for similar reasons.
